symptom: On a Mendix 11.17 project, `create snippet M.S (Params: ( $Label: String ))` was refused as MDL087 / CE0046 ('a snippet parameter must be an entity'), though 11.17 added primitive snippet parameters; `textbox (Attribute: $Label)` on a primitive page or snippet parameter was refused as MDL-WIDGET34 ('not a page variable'); and a page variable passed to a snippet call was refused as CE0115. Studio Pro 11.17's own primitive snippet described with its inputs unbound.
file: mdl/types/snippet_parameter_types.go, mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go buildSnippetV3 / resolveTemplateAttributePathFull, cmd_pages_input_binding_context.go pageVariableInputBinding, cmd_pages_builder_v3_widgets.go buildSnippetCallParams, cmd_pages_describe_parse.go extractInputAttribute, version_gates.go
cause: The refusal was a measurement on 11.13 stated as a rule with no version. Lifting it alone was not enough: the snippet builder only typed entity parameters, so a primitive was written as a DataTypes$ObjectType naming no entity, which mx 11.17 cannot load; a template binding named a snippet's primitive in the PageParameter slot (CE0402 + CE7005); inputs only bound page variables; and the call builder refused every page-variable argument because snippet parameters used to be objects.
fix: A measured version gate pages/snippet_parameter_primitive (11.17.0) applied by the statement gates, the builder and alter add; the builder types the parameter and binds inputs and templates in the SnippetParameter slot (PageParameter on a page); a page variable is refused only for an entity snippet parameter; describe prints a parameter-slot input binding as `$name`. MDL087 keeps only `optional`.
insight: A refusal recorded from one version's measurement is a version gate waiting to happen: write the version into it. When the platform lifts a restriction, the code that never ran behind the refusal (here, typing and binding a primitive snippet parameter) is untested, and turning the refusal off writes something worse than the error — an unloadable document. Measure the lift with the refusal removed, revert each piece, and run the same bytes on the release before (11.16.0: CE0046) and after (11.17.0: 0 errors).
test: mdl/executor/snippet_param_primitive_test.go (11.16 refused, 11.17 typed, snippet-slot bindings, page-variable argument, statement gates), cmd_alter_page_mock_test.go TestAlterSnippet_AddPrimitiveParameterGatedAt1117, cmd_pages_describe_primitive_param_input_test.go, validate_snippet_parameters_test.go; each failed with its fix reverted
